claim.claim-text: 1. A console (422) of a medical system (420), the medical system configured to provide tissue treatment and treatment visualization, the console (422) comprising:

2. The console (422) of claim 1, wherein the console is configured to provide bars of the proximity meter (494) in one of three colors for display by the monitor (444), depending on whether a tip of the handheld ablation device (16) is in front of, behind, or on, the ultrasound imaging plane (352).

3. The console (422) of claim 1, wherein the console is configured to provide bars of the proximity meter (494) in a first color for display by the monitor if a tip of the ablation device (16) is in front of the ultrasound imaging plane (352).

4. The console (422) of claim 3, wherein the console is configured to provide the bars of the proximity meter (494) in a second color for display by the monitor if the tip of the ablation device (16) is behind the ultrasound imaging plane (352), the second color being different from the first color.

5. The console (422) of claim 4, wherein the console is configured to provide the bars of the proximity meter (494) in a third color for display by the monitor (444) if the tip of the ablation device (16) is on the ultrasound imaging plane (352), the third color being different from the first color and from the second color.
6. The console (422) of claim 1, further comprising an ultrasound depth adjustment button (458) for adjusting an ultrasound depth.
7. The console (422) of claim 6, wherein the ultrasound depth adjustment button (458) is configured to adjust the ultrasound depth to: 3 cm, 4 cm, 5 cm, 6 cm, 7 cm, 8 cm, or 9 cm.
8. The console (422) of claim 1, further comprising an ultrasound frequency adjustment button (460) for adjusting an ultrasound frequency.
9. The console (422) of claim 8, wherein the ultrasound frequency adjustment button (460) is configured to adjust the ultrasound frequency to: 5 MHz, 6 MHz, 9 MHz, or 12 MHz.
10. The console (422) of claim 1, further comprising an ultrasound focus adjustment button (464) for adjusting an ultrasound focal depth.

11. The console (422) of claim 10, wherein the ultrasound focus adjustment button (464) is configured to adjust the ultrasound focal depth to: 0.2 cm, 0.4 cm, 0.7 cm, 1.0 cm, 1.4 cm, 1.8 cm, 2.3 cm, 3.0 cm, 4.0 cm, 5.0 cm, 6.0 cm, or 8.0 cm.
12. The console (422) of claim 1, wherein the console is configured to couple to provide an expected 3D ablation cage or treatment zone (500) for display by the monitor (444).
13. The console (422) of claim 12, wherein a size of the expected 3D ablation cage or the treatment zone (500) is based on a preset target temperature.
14. The console (422) of claim 12, wherein a size of the expected 3D ablation cage or the treatment zone (500) is based on a deployment length of stylets (20) of the ablation device (16).
